title: Product capability
description: One capability of a product, or a category that groups capabilities, at <venture>/product/capabilities/<id>.json (EE-224). Capabilities form a tree under the products function: a category's parent is another category or null (it sits directly under the products function), and a capability always has a category as its parent. Each names the agent role that owns it, the one that keeps its words and its site or docs containers current. A capability is live, building or retired, and nothing under a retired category is live or building (node packages/naive/src/checks/check-ventures.ts).

name.description: The capability as a customer would name it, for example Time travel

product.description: The product it belongs to: a product card's id in product/ or products/

kind.description: A category groups capabilities and other categories; a capability is one thing the product does

parent.description: The category it sits under, or null for a category directly under the products function

owner.description: The agent role that owns it: <capability>-agent for a capability, the category agent for a category. A container in a site's containers.json names the same role as its owner

summary.description: What it does, in one or two plain sentences
